manifest.scope: completed-run metrics CSV corroborated by final DEF and native signoff reports

summary.fmaxMethod: derived as 1e9 / (clock period - reference setup slack)

interpretation.scope: completed-run metrics CSV corroborated by final DEF and native signoff reports

timing_aggregate.fmax_method: derived as 1e9 / (clock period - reference setup slack)

boundaries: GF180 DIEAREA_mm^2 in OpenLane metrics.csv is affected by a DBU scaling bug; normalized die area is recomputed from final DEF coordinates and UNITS.
OpenLane 1 power_*_uW CSV headers are mislabeled: report.py stores OpenSTA watts. Native power reports are authoritative here and are converted W * 1000 to mW.
Reference setup/hold slack comes from the typical post-route report; rc_min/max/nom entries are worst-library summaries and are retained separately.
Magic DRC counts violation boxes, not unique rule names; route DRC and Magic DRC are separate checker domains.
OpenLane's IR report is not normalized because GF180 logs can use an implicit 0 V supply; an absent value is never interpreted as zero drop.

normalized_metric_provenance.transformation: minimum setup slack across retained reference/RC summaries
minimum hold slack across retained reference/RC summaries
0 when native reference slack is non-negative
0 when native reference slack is non-negative
sum unrounded internal + switching + leakage values

corner_analysis.mode: three extracted-RC signoff analyses; every analysis defines Slowest/Typical/Fastest with SS/TT/FF

standard_cell_usage.scope: all final-DEF COMPONENT master instances, including functional and physical-only standard cells

timing_endpoint_slacks.scope: one worst setup and hold check per constrained timed endpoint at the final post-route reference corner
